newsitem.title: SOMALIA: Aid worker attacked in Somalia, doctors say.
newsitem.headline: Aid worker attacked in Somalia, doctors say.

text.p: Gunmen shot and wounded a U.N. aid worker in Somalia on Monday after trying to kidnap him, doctors said.

They said Abdullahi Mayow Mahad, a warehouse officer for the United Nations Children's Fund (UNICEF), was shot in the stomach in south Mogadishu after he refused to follow the orders of the would-be kidnappers. He was being treated at Hassan Jiis hospital.
Another aid worker, Hilal Aden of the Swedish Life and Peace Institute, was kidnapped in Mogadishu on September 19 and is still missing.
Aid agencies have suspended all "non-vital" operations in the war-damaged and divided Somali capital in an attempt to press for his release.
